title: The AI Daily — Morning Conversation
blurb: An American-English dialogue limited to publisher feed excerpts.
lines: Hey, welcome to The AI Daily. I'm Maya, and Ben is here with me. We've picked a few headlines from publisher news feeds to talk through.
Hi, Maya. These are short feed excerpts, not the full articles, so we'll keep the facts carefully attributed and avoid filling in the blanks.
Let's start with OpenAI. The headline is: LVMH’s Media Division announces strategic partnership with OpenAI.
According to the publisher's excerpt, LVMH’s Media Division and OpenAI announce a partnership to support journalism with AI and make its publications more accessible through…
That brings us to Crunchbase News, which has this headline: VC Firm Plural Closes On $1.1B To Invest In European Startups With Potential For ‘GDP-Level Impact’.
According to the publisher's excerpt, London-based startup investor Plural, with a portfolio mix of energy, compute, defense, robotics, health and software, says it has closed…
Next up, The Decoder reports: Australia's central bank finds AI hitting young workers first, especially in software and customer service.
According to the publisher's excerpt, Australia's central bank sees early signs that AI is hitting young entry-level workers in highly exposed jobs like software development…
And our fourth story is from Wired: This Startup Is Betting on AI Microdramas to Get More Black Stories in Hollywood.
According to the publisher's excerpt, Mansa says its AI microdramas can serve as proofs of concept for what Black audiences want. Critics say the studio…
Before we go, here's a useful expression: keep an eye on. It means watch something for changes — like a fast-moving AI story.
Exactly. And look into means investigate further. Follow the original reporting for context. See you in the next edition.
note: AI voices reading a conservative two-host script grounded only in publisher feed excerpts. Full article claims were not independently verified.
